I like a game where mashing and parries coexist. People say this game is clunky. I prefer the term Meaty. The grind still feels kinda bad at the moment I type this, but at least once you get the hang of blocks, parries and dodging, you can turn your brain off while playing.

It's fun, haven't tried any PvP yet, which I enjoy usually more than PVE games.  Wife and I though, we enjoy the Story mode for when we aren't playing together and the PvE mode for when we want to run co-op.  We really like the customization, we really like the combat (although it takes some getting used to because of animation time) and love the fact that the coop mode seems to be tied into the main stories, just showing you the supporting squads and the other objectives of that planet.

All in all, I tried it way back at launch and refunded.  Bought it again last week on sale while I wait for Arc or Marathon to work out their rat problems, let's be honest, for online gaming to work out its CHEATING problem and so we picked this up since it was already on PSN Plus for my wife and her PS5.  We have been having a blast, Co-op missions can be sorta long, and with us being older her arthritis acts up and we only can do one session at a time.  Other than that, A+.  Play on an LG C2 OLED @ 4k, DLSS on Performance (I prefer the sharpening difference at this level compared to Quality) and the 4k texture pack.  Game pops man, looks great!
For the glory of the emperor
